title: DEdit
description:
DEdit is a Decentralized Cloud base image editor where users can create their profile using 3BOX and upload their Photos to IPFS and also fetch their images and edit inside a web browser and update on the IPFS. Currently, this app is not fully completed and not working properly. there a need to spend some time making it fully working app. As a student, it's my first experience to participate in that kind of hackathon.
That's why I am not able to build it fully.
how_its_made: This Project is using IPFS for storing images. On the backend, my plane uses a @3BOX that stores users' information and there related data or images on IPFS using  Filecoin. but due to having less experience in that kind of project, I am not able to build fully functional applications. for the front-end I use ReactJs.
